key_insight: LocateAnything replaces token-by-token coordinate generation with Parallel Box Decoding so each 2D box is decoded as a coupled unit in parallel, eliminating the sequential generation bottleneck and better modeling box geometry. This yields faster inference and higher-quality visual grounding/detection.
problem_solved: Current VLM grounding and detection serialize boxes into independent 1D coordinate tokens and decode them sequentially, which mismatches the coupled nature of box geometry and creates a practical inference speed and quality bottleneck.
method: Parallel Box Decoding: group each bounding box's coordinates into a single jointly decoded unit instead of serializing into independent tokens, enabling parallel prediction of multiple boxes.
Unified generative grounding framework: integrate parallel box decoding into a vision–language model so language-conditioned location predictions and detection coexist in one generative pipeline.
Architecture and training adjustments: couple geometric decoding with cross-attention and task-specific losses so box geometry and language cues are learned jointly for accurate, fast localization.
impact: Makes vision-language grounding and detection substantially faster and more accurate by aligning the model's output structure with true box geometry; this improves throughput for real-time and large-scale applications and simplifies deployment of unified VLM detectors.
visual_elements: Schematic comparison: sequential token-by-token box decoding vs. parallel box decoding (showing fewer steps and grouped box outputs).
Speed vs. quality chart: inference latency reduction on x-axis and localization accuracy improvement on y-axis, illustrating Pareto gains.
Pipeline diagram: image + text input → unified VLM → parallel box decoder → multiple bounding boxes (with language alignment).
Qualitative examples: sample images with language queries and predicted boxes, highlighting tighter, more accurate boxes and faster runtime.
paper_title: LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding
paper_authors: Shihao Wang, Shilong Liu, Yuanguo Kuang, Xinyu Wei, Yangzhou Liu
